name: CommentCard
description: The card of one discussion: its comments, a line such as "2 replies", and the reply box when it is open. A `div`; which parts it holds (collapsed or open) is the caller's choice. To open it with a click, add `CommentCardTrigger`.

props.name: active
props.description: The discussion people are reading or replying to: an ink border, lifted.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: CommentCardMeta
description: A short line about the discussion, in the caller's words: how many replies it has, that it is about the whole document, or that the passage it was on can no longer be found.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: CommentCardQuote
description: The passage the discussion is about, in the caller's words (usually the quoted text). Hidden on screen, where the card's place beside the highlighted passage says it; give it an `id` and point the `aria-describedby` of `CommentCardTrigger` or `CommentMarker` at it, so a screen reader says which passage a card is about.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: CommentCardTrigger
description: A button laid over the whole card, for a collapsed card that opens when it is clicked or chosen with the keyboard. It has no text of its own: give it an `aria-label` ("Comment from Martin").

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: CommentEntry
description: One comment in a discussion: its header, then its text.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: CommentEntryAuthor
description: Who wrote the comment, in bold. It truncates; the time after it doesn't.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: clamp
props.description: Cuts the text to 2 lines, for a collapsed card.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: CommentEntryTime
description: When the comment was written, right after the author. A `<time>`: pass the moment in `dateTime` (ISO 8601).

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: CommentMargin
description: The column beside a document that holds its comment cards, each level with the passage it is about. It measures its `CommentMarginItem`s with one `ResizeObserver`, resolves their collisions with `resolveCommentMarginLayout`, and takes the height the lowest card needs. Place it beside the document so that its top is the top the items' `top` is measured from.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between two cards that would otherwise touch, in px. Default 8.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: CommentMarginItem
description: One card's place in a `CommentMargin`. It sits at `top`, or lower when the card above it is in the way; the active one stays at `top` and the others make room. Items with the same `top` keep the order they were first rendered in. The resolved top is `data-top`, applied as a `translateY`.

props.name: active
props.description: Pins this card to its anchor and moves the others around it.

props.name: top
props.description: Where the card's anchor is: its y, in px, from the top of the margin.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: CommentMarker
description: Where there is no room for a margin: a small button beside a passage that has comments, with the authors' avatars (an `AvatarGroup` of up to 3 `size="2xs"` avatars) and the count. It opens the discussion, in a bottom sheet. Give it an `aria-label` that starts with the count ("2 comments").

props.name: active
props.description: The marker of the discussion that is open.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
